findings.description: Modern Turkish national flags fly on medieval fortress towers, and the inner city features modern suburban grid housing layout.
findings.fix: Replace flags with period-accurate Ottoman banners and update background buildings to 15th-century architecture.
findings.refined_description: Modern Turkish national flags with the white crescent and star are shown waving on top of the medieval stone fortress towers, while the city beyond the breach features an anachronistic, uniform suburban grid-style street layout with identical modern red-tiled roof buildings.

findings.description: The army column exhibits rigid sliding movement through the breach while foreground artillery crews remain completely frozen.
findings.fix: Apply individual walking animations to marching soldiers and activate surrounding extra figures.
findings.refined_description: The army column displays walking animations with legs moving forward rather than rigid sliding, and surrounding soldiers exhibit subtle idle and walking motions rather than being completely frozen.

summary: The visual composition effectively captures scale and atmospheric lighting alongside clear narrative audio. Historical inaccuracies like modern flags and modern town planning diminish immersion. Rigid troop motion highlights standard generative video motion artifacts.
